2manteam.label: 2-man Team
2manteam.description: Takes a maximum of 50% of its max Health in Damage from a single hit. Does not apply to Blast Damage. Once below 50% of its max Health, cannot be healed above 50% of its max Health again.

actoffaith.label: Act of Faith
actoffaith.description: This unit gets +10% Crit Chance and increases their Crit Damage by 25% each time a friendly Imperial unit dies or kills an enemy unit. Once this unit crits, this bonus resets.

ambush.label: Ambush
ambush.description: The first time this unit is defeated, it leaves behind a decoy and at the beginning of their next turn, if there is still a friendly decoy on the battlefield, it is resurrected with full Health on a random friendly decoy and can immediately take a turn. Characters resurrect before Non-Character units.

battlefatigue.label: Battle Fatigue
battlefatigue.description: If a friendly unit is defeated in an adjacent hex, there’s a 10% chance that this unit flees and is removed from the battle. +40% if it was overkilled.

beastslayer.label: Beast Slayer
beastslayer.description: This unit deals +20% Damage with melee attacks to Big Targets and Vehicles. It also has an added 10% chance to Block Damage equal to its current Armour.

beastsnagga.label: Beast Slayer
beastsnagga.description: Deals +20% melee Damage to Big Targets and Vehicles. Has an added 10% chance to Block 20% of its max Health as Damage.

bigtarget.label: Big Target
bigtarget.description: Due to its size, this unit benefits less from cover but also provides some obstruction to enemy sighting. Does not get any bonuses from Tall Grass and Trenches. Adjacent friendly units receive -1 hit from ranged attacks, to a minimum of 1. Cannot be displaced.

blessingsofkhorne.label: Blessings of Khorne
blessingsofkhorne.description: Deals 3% more damage and receives 8% less Psychic Damage for each unit that was defeated in melee this battle. Counts up to a maximum of 8 defeated units.

bossadjutant.label: Boss Adjutant
bossadjutant.description: This unit takes -66% Damage. At the end of each turn, this unit loses 1% of its current Health for each time it was attacked that turn.

camouflage.label: Camouflage
camouflage.description: Ranged attacks against this character score -1 hit. This increases to -2 hits if this character is more than 2 hexes away from the attacker or to -3 hits when in Tall Grass. Attackers always score at least 1 hit.

closecombatweakness.label: Close Combat Weakness
closecombatweakness.description: Whenever this unit is adjacent – or started the turn adjacent – to enemy units, it deals -50% Damage with melee attacks and -25% Damage with ranged attacks.

contagionsofnurgle.label: Contagions of Nurgle
contagionsofnurgle.description:
This unit is surrounded by an aura that expands over time. Enemies have -20% Armour while in this aura. If they stand in two or more overlapping enemy auras, they have -40% Armour instead.
Aura:
Round 1-2: range 1
Round 3-4: range 2
Round 5+: range 3

crushingstrike.label: Crushing Strike
crushingstrike.description: This unit deals +50% Damage with normal Melee attacks if it has not moved this turn.

daemon.label: Daemon
daemon.description: This unit has an additional 25% chance to Block up to 50% of its own current Damage stat.

dakka.label: Dakka
dakka.description: For attacks with range 3 or more, has +2 hits if the target is at range 2.

deepstrike.label: Deep Strike
deepstrike.description:
This unit starts the battle in Deep Strike.
Units in Deep Strike can move to any free hex on the battlefield that is not adjacent to an enemy, or they can move normally from their current position. They cannot be targeted or damaged until they have taken an action or ended their turn.

diminutive.label: Diminutive
diminutive.description: Due to its tiny stature, this unit reduces incoming multi-hit attacks by 1 hit, to a minimum of 1.

emplacement.label: Emplacement
emplacement.description: This unit always deals -50% Damage in melee and its ranged attacks deal +50% Damage if it has not moved this turn.

explodes.label: Explodes
explodes.description: This unit explodes on death, dealing 25% of its max Health as Direct Damage to all adjacent units

finaljustice.label: Final Vengeance
finaljustice.description: When this unit loses its last Health, it immediately performs a normal attack on an eligible target and is then defeated as normal, unless Overkilled

finalvengeance.label: Final Vengeance
finalvengeance.description: When this unit loses its last Health, it immediately performs a normal attack on an eligible target and is then defeated as normal, unless Overkilled

flying.label: Flying
flying.description: Can traverse impassable hexes and enemies and move between any elevation.

getstuckin.label: Get Stuck In
getstuckin.description: For every 2 hits this unit scores with an attack against an enemy within range 2, it has a 30% chance to score an additional hit. If 2 or more friendly Orks or 4 or more friendly units are adjacent to the target, the chance is increased to 100%.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description:
Can heal a friendly unit as its action.
The amount of Health restored equals the Healer’s Damage multiplied by the highest number of hits of any of their weapons.

heavyweapon.label: Heavy Weapon
heavyweapon.description: When this unit has not moved this turn, it deals +25% Damage with ranged attacks.

immune.label: Immune
immune.description:
This unit is immune to special hexes and hex effects, and cannot have its Armour, hits, Movement or Range reduced.
Additionally, this unit cannot be Stunned, Suppressed or Taunted, and does not receive knockback damage.

impervious.label: Impervious
impervious.description: Has to be hit by a Crit to take any Damage, but is instantly defeated by a Crit.

indirectfire.label: Indirect Fire
indirectfire.description: Can fire over obscuring hexes and hit targets in Trenches

infiltrate.label: Infiltrate
infiltrate.description: This unit does not trigger Overwatch

instinctivebehaviour.label: Instinctive Behaviour
instinctivebehaviour.description: This unit always tries to attack the closest enemy unit. If there are targets in range, this unit does not move before attacking.

letthegalaxyburn.label: Let the Galaxy Burn
letthegalaxyburn.description: All attacks have a 33% chance to score an additional hit and add Despoiled Ground to the hex of the attacked unit. If the attacked unit is already on a hex with a hex effect, the attack automatically scores an additional hit but does not add Despoiled Ground.

livingmetal.label: Living Metal
livingmetal.description: Regenerates 10% of its max Health at the start of the players' turn. This unit is also Mechanical

machineofwar.label: Machine of War
machineofwar.description:
Machines of War stand beside the battlefield and provide two additional powerful abilities to use multiple times during the battle. Some of them cost Munitions and some have a cooldown before you can use them. Machines of War cannot be targeted in their off-battlefield position and are destroyed when a battle is lost.
Not every game mode allows to field Machines of War!

martialkatah.label: Martial Ka'tah
martialkatah.description: Normal attacks against this unit deal -20% Damage. This unit deals +100% Damage with all attacks against Summons.

mechanic.label: Mechanic
mechanic.description:
Can repair a friendly Mechanical unit as its action.
The amount of Health restored equals the Mechanic's Damage multiplied by the highest number of hits of any of their weapons.

mechanical.label: Mechanical
mechanical.description:
Cannot be healed, but can be repaired instead.
Note: units with the Living Metal trait also count as being Mechanical

mkxgravis.label: Mk X Gravis
mkxgravis.description: Any incoming Damage has to go through Armour a second time. Does not apply to Crits

object.label: Object
object.description: Automatically takes its action, if any, at the beginning of the turn. Cannot be healed or repaired. A player loses the battle if their only remaining units are Objects

overwatch.label: Overwatch
overwatch.description: If this unit has not attacked during its turn, nor after that, it attacks when an enemy moves within range during the enemy's turn

parry.label: Parry
parry.description: This unit reduces incoming melee multi-hit attacks by 1 hit, to a minimum of 1.

prioritisedefficiency.label: Prioritised Efficiency
prioritisedefficiency.description:
At the beginning of each turn and until the end of that turn, this unit gains an effect depending on its stance. Whenever a friendly character with Prioritised Efficiency uses an active ability, the stance switches for all friendly units with this trait.
Hostile Acquisition: Deals +25% Damage with all attacks and gains +1 Movement.
Fortify Takeover: Takes -33% Damage.

psyker.label: Psyker
psyker.description: When this unit performs a normal ranged attack, it also deals 50% of its Damage to a random enemy adjacent to the target.

putridexplosion.label: Putrid Explosion
putridexplosion.description: This unit explodes when defeated, dealing 25% of its max Health as Toxic Damage to all adjacent units except to Death Guard units.

rangedspecialist.label: Ranged Specialist
rangedspecialist.description: If this unit did not start its turn adjacent to an enemy unit, it deals +33% Damage with ranged attacks.

rapidassault.label: Rapid Assault
rapidassault.description: This unit has +1 Movement until it makes either a melee or ranged attack. Its first attack each battle and all following attacks it makes in the same turn deal +25% Damage.

resilient.label: Resilient
resilient.description: If this unit is not already at 1 Health and would be defeated, its Health is instead reduced to 1 Health, unless Overkilled.

shadowinthewarp.label: Shadow in the Warp
shadowinthewarp.description: Enemy Psykers within 2 hexes deal -25% Psychic Damage. Does not affect Tyranid Psykers.

steppable.label: Steppable
steppable.description: Will be destroyed if stepped on or if damaged, but cannot be targeted.

summon.label: Summon
summon.description: Moves and attacks automatically at the beginning of its turn

suppressivefire.label: Suppressive Fire
suppressivefire.description: An enemy hit by this unit’s ranged attack becomes Suppressed.

swarm.label: Swarm
swarm.description:
Attacks with 1 hit per individual member of the swarm. Each incoming hit can deal Damage only to one member. Does not apply to Blast Damage.
For each member defeated, the swarm attacks with 1 fewer hit.
Healing this unit can revive dead members of the swarm.

synapse.label: Synapse
synapse.description: Friendly units within 2 hexes ignore the effects of Instinctive Behaviour and Battle Fatigue.

teleportstrike.label: Deep Strike
teleportstrike.description:
This unit starts the battle in Deep Strike.
Units in Deep Strike can move to any free hex on the battlefield that is not adjacent to an enemy, or they can move normally from their current position. They cannot be targeted or damaged until they have taken an action or ended their turn.

terminatorarmour.label: Terminator Armour
terminatorarmour.description: The first attack each turn against this unit deals -75% Damage. Hits dealing Psychic or Direct Damage are excluded. This unit cannot be Suppressed.

thrillseekers.label: Thrill Seekers
thrillseekers.description: Each turn, when this unit takes Damage or targets an enemy with full Health, it becomes Thrilled for 1 round. While Thrilled, its Crit Chance is increased by +15% and if it defeats an enemy with a Crit, that enemy is always overkilled.

twomanteam.label: 2-man Team
twomanteam.description: Takes a maximum of 50% of its max Health in Damage from a single hit. Does not apply to Blast Damage. Once below 50% of its max Health, cannot be healed above 50% of its max Health again.

unstoppable.label: Unstoppable
unstoppable.description: This unit does not have to stop on special hexes and hex effects that would normally force a unit to end their Movement.

vehicle.label: Vehicle
vehicle.description: This unit does not have to stop on special hexes and hex effects that would normally force a unit to end their Movement. Does not get any bonuses from Tall Grass and Trenches. This unit is also Mechanical.

weaveroffate.label: Weaver Of Fates
weaveroffate.description: In any turn where 3 or more enemy units have taken Psychic Damage, this unit will deal the maximum possible Damage with its attacks and abilities on that turn.

weaveroffates.label: Weaver Of Fates
weaveroffates.description: In any turn where 3 or more enemy units have taken Psychic Damage, this unit will deal the maximum possible Damage with its attacks and abilities on that turn.
